verses.en: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.
verses.sm: UA valaau ia Elisaia le avā a le tasi soo o le au perofeta, ua faapea mai, Ua oti lau auauna o la‘u tane, ua e silafia foi sa mata‘u lau auauna ia Ieova, a ua sau le ua matou aitalafu i ai, o le a na ave i a‘u tama tane e toalua e fai mona pologa.

verses.en: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Elisaia ia te ia, Se a ea se mea ou te faia ia te oe ? Ina ta‘u ma'i ia ia te au, pe se a se mea o ia te oe i le fale ? Ona tali mai ai lea o ia, E leai se mea a lau auauna fafine o i lol'u fale, ua lāa o le fagu suāuu lava.

verses.en: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia, Ina alu ia, ia e no ipu i tuā i tagata uma ua lata mai ia te oe, o ipu le susua, aua le itiiti.

verses.en: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
verses.sm: A e ulufale ane, ia e pupuni le faitotoa i ou tua ma tua o au tama, i le e liligi atu i na ipu uma, ma tuu ese le ua tumu.

verses.en: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.
verses.sm: Ona alu ane ai lea o ia, ua tapuni le faitotoa i ona tua ma tua o ana tama; ona la au mai ai lea o ipu ia te ia, ona liligi atu ai lea e ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.
verses.sm: Ua tutumu ipu, ona fai atu lea o ia i lana tama, Ia toe au mai se isi ipu ia te a‘u ; ona fai mai ai lea o ia ia te ia, E leai se toe ipu. Ona utu ai lea o le suāuu.

verses.en: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o ia, ua ta‘u atu i le tagata o le Atua. Ona fai mai ai lea o ia ia te ia, Alu ia, ina faatau atu le suāuu, i le e taui atu i le tagata ua outou aitalafu ai; a o mea ua totoe ia ola ai oe ma au tama.

verses.en: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
verses.sm: O le tasi aso na ui atu ai Elisaia i Sunema, sa i ai le tasi sa‘o tamaitai; na ia pulunaunau mai ia te ia seH ‘ai. Ona iu ai lea ina afe soo ai o ia e ‘ai ai i ana malaga i lea ala.

verses.en: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia i lana tane, Faauta mai, ua ou iloa o le tagata paia o le Atua lenei, o le sau soo ia te i taua.

verses.en: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
verses.sm: Ia ta faia se afeafe itiiti i luga e fai i le pa puipui o le fale; ia ta tuu ai se moega mo ia, ma se laulau, ma se nofoa, ma se tuugālamepa; a sau foi o ia ia te i taua, i le alu ane i ai o ia.

verses.en: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
verses.sm: O le tasi aso na oo atu ai o ia i lea mea, ona ulu ane lea i le afeafe, ua taoto ai.

verses.en: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu o ia. ia Kiasi lana auauna, Valaau ia i lena tamaitai Sunema. Ona valaau lea o ia ia te ia, ona tu mai ai lea o ia i ona luma.

verses.en: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia ia te ia, Ia e fai atu i ai- Faauta, ua tigaina oe ona o i maua i nei sauniga uma, se a se mea e faia mo oe ? pe ta‘u ea oe i le tupu, po o le alii e pule i au? Ona tali mai ai lea o ia, Ou te nofo faatasi ma lo‘u nuu.

verses.en: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.
verses.sm: Ona fai ane lea o ia, Se a se mea e faia mo ia ? Ona tali mai ai lea o Kiasi, E leai sana tama, ua toeaina foi lana tane.

verses.en: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia, Valaau atu ia te ia. Ona valaau atu lea o ia ia te ia, ona tu mai ai lea o ia i le faitotoa.

verses.en: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia, O lela tausaga, e te sapasapai i sau tama tane. Ona tali mai lea o ia, Aua, le alii e, le tagata o le Atua, aua e te ‘ole‘ole mai i lau auauna fafine.

verses.en: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
verses.sm: Ona to ai lea o le fafine, ua fanau mai ai lana tama tane i lea tausaga, e faatatau i le tau o le olaga sa fai atu ai Elisaia ia te ia.

verses.en: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
verses.sm: Ua matua le tama, ona oo lea i le tasi aso, ua alu atu ai o ia i lona tamā i e na sele saito.

verses.en: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu ia i lona tamā, Lo‘u ulu e, lo‘u ulu e! Ona fai atu ai lea o ia i se tasi taulealea na te avea o ia i lona tinā.

verses.en: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
verses.sm: Ona ave lea e ia, ua avatu ai i lona tinā; ona sii lea o ia i ona vae, ua oo ina tutonu o le la, ona oti ai lea o ia.

verses.en: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.
verses.sm: Ona alu ae lea o le fafine^ ua faataoto ia te ia i luga o le moega o le tagata o le Atua, ua pupuni le faitotoa,onsi alu lea o ia i fafo.

verses.en: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.
verses.sm: Ona valaau atu ai lea o ia i lana tane, ua faapea atu, Se‘i e auna mai ia te au se tasi taulealea ma se asini, ou te vave atu ai i le tagata o le Atua, i lo‘u toe sau ai.

verses.en: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o ia, O le a le mea e te alu ai ia te ia i le aso nei ? e le o le masina faatoa vaaia lenei, e le o le sapati foi. A ua tali atu ai o ia, E le afaina.

verses.en: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.
verses.sm: Ona faanofoa lea e ia o le asini, ua fai atu i lana auauna, Ia faatelevave ona alu, aua ne‘i faatelegese ona faamomo‘e ona o a‘u, se‘i iloga ou fai atu ai ia te oe.

verses.en: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o ia, ua oo atu i le tagata o le Atua i le mauga o Karamelu. Ua iloa mamao mai foi o ia e le tagata o le Atua, ona fai ane ai lea o ia ia Kiasi lana auauna, Faauta i lena tamaitai Sunema.

verses.en: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.
verses.sm: Ina momo‘e ia oe e faafetaiai ia te ia, fai atu foi i ai, E manuia ea oe ? e manuia ea lau tane ? e manuia ea le tama ? Ona tali mai lea o ia, Ua manuia lava.

verses.en: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the LORD hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.
verses.sm: Ua oo mai o ia i le tagata o le Atua i le mauga, ona (u!u lea o ia i ona vae; a ua faalatalata ane Kiasi, o le a tulei ese la te ia. A ua fai atu le tagata o le Atua, Ina tuu pea ia ia te ia, auā ua tiga lona loto ; a ua nanā e Ieova le mea ia te au, e lei faaalia mai ia te au.

verses.en: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o ia, Na ou ole atu ea i se tama tane i lo‘u alii? na ou le fai atu ea, Aua e te ‘ole4ole mai ia te au ?

verses.en: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia ia Kiasi, Ina fusi ia lou sulugatiti, ia e ave foi lo‘u tootoo i lou lima, ma ia e alu atu ; a oulua fetaiai ma se isi, aua ne‘i e ofo alofa ia te ia; a alofa mai foi se tasi ia te oe, aua e te toe tali atu i ai; ma ia e faaee lo4u tootoo i mata o le tama.

verses.en: And the mother of the child said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o le tinā o le tama, O loo soifua Ieova, ua e ola foi oe, ou te le te‘a ese ia te oe. Ona tulai lea o ia, ua mulimuli ia te ia.

verses.en: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
verses.sm: Ua muamua atu Kiasi ia te i latou, ua faaee le tootoo i mata o le tama; a ua leai se leo, ua le lagona foi. Ona foi mai lea o ia e faafetaiai ia te ia; ua fai mai foi ia te ia, ua faapea mai, E lei ala le tama.

verses.en: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
verses.sm: Ua ulufale atu Elisaia i le fale,faauta foi,o le tama ua oti, ua faataoto i luga o lona moega.

verses.en: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua ulu atu o ia, ua pupuni foi le faitotoa, ua i totonu i laua, ona tatalo atu ai lea o ia ia Ieova.

verses.en: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
verses.sm: Ona alu ae lea o ia, ua faō i luga o le tama ; ua faatatau lona gutu i lona gutu, ma ona mata i ona mata, ma ona lima i ona lima; ua taoto o ia i ona luga; ona mafanafana lea o le tino o le tama.

verses.en: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verses.sm: Ona foi atu lea o ia, ua taifoifaatasi ona savali i le loto fale ; ona alu ae &i lea, ua taoto o ia i ona luga; ona mafatua faafitu ai lea o le tama, ua pupula ae foi mata o le tama.

verses.en: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
verses.sm: Ona valaau lea o ia ia Kiasi, ua faapea atu, Valaau ia i lena tamaitai Sunema. Ona valaau atu lea o ia i ai. Ua sau foi o ia ia te ia, ona fai atu ai lea o ia, Sii ae ia o lau tama.

verses.en: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
verses.sm: Ona ulu mai lea o ia, ua faapaū i ona vae, ua ifo toele; ona sii mai lea o lana tama, ua alu.

verses.en: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.
verses.sm: Ua toe alu atu Elisaia i Kilikala ; ua oge le nuu ; ua nonofo foi i ona atu lea o ia i lana auauna, Faaee ia le pani tele i le afi, e tunu ai ni mea e ‘ai mā soo o le au perofeta.

verses.en: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o le tasi i le vao e saili mea e ‘ai, ua maua se vine vao, ua tau ai ona fua, ua tumu ai lona ie, ona sau ai lea, ua tipi i le pani sa tunu a‘i mea e ‘ai; auā ua latou le iloa ia mea.

verses.en: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
verses.sm: Ona latou liligi atu ai lea e aai ai tagata. O aai i latou i le mea na tunu, ona latou alalaga lea, ua faapea mai, Le tagata o le Atua e, ua i le pani le oti. Ua le mafai ona latou aai ai.

verses.en: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
verses.sm: A ua fai atu o ia, Ina aumaia se falaoa. Ona lafo lea e ia i le pani, oua fai atu ai lea, Liligi atu ia mā le nuu, latou te aai ai. Ua le toe ai se meā leaga i le pani.

verses.en: And there came a man from Baal-shalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
verses.sm: Ua sau le tasi tagata mai Paalasalisa, ua au mai i le tagata o le Atua o le mea e ‘ai o uluai fua, o areto karite e fua lua, atoa ma fu* saito mata i lana taga. Ona fai atu lea o ia, Avatu ia mā le nuu, latou te aai ai.

verses.en: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o lana auauna, Pe a ou laulauina atu ea mea nei i luma o tagata e toaselau ? Ona toe fai atu lea o ia, Ina laulau atu ia mā le nuu, ina ia latou aai ai; auā o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o Ieova, Latou te aai ai, a e totoe lava.

verses.en: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona laulau atu ai lea e ia i o latou luma, ua latou aai ai, ma ua totoe lava, pei ona fetalai mai ai o Ieova. Ua faamaloloina Naamanu le Suria.
